blocks.text: Hum rubber ke pipe ko daba kar us mein pani ki flow velocity barha sakte hain. Jab hum rubber ka pipe dabate hain to hum woh cross-sectional raqba ghatate hain jis se pani bahta hai. Equation of continuity ke mutabiq A1 v1 = A2 v2 ... (5.18), jahan A cross-sectional raqba aur v flow velocity hai. Cross-sectional raqba ghatane se (A2, A1 se kam) wahi flow rate qaim rakhne ko pani ki velocity (v2) barhni chahiye. Is liye rubber ka pipe dabana pani ki flow velocity barhata hai.

blocks.prompt: Bagh ka hose daba kar us ka munh chauthai kar diya jata hai; pani ki speed aur fi second nikalne wale volume ka kya hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Speed chaar guna ho jati hai, kyunke A v mustaqil hai, jabke fi second nikalne wala volume wahi rehta hai (tang nozzle ki thori izafi rukawat nazar andaz kar ke).

items: Rubber ka pipe dabane se A ghatta hai, to A1 v1 = A2 v2 se pani tez hota hai; flow rate wahi rehti hai.
